Alongside the dashboard, I need a configurable redirect handler. A simple rules engine or endpoint that reads parameters and pushes them to the right destination will cover it.  

Tech stack is flexible: React, Vue, or plain JavaScript on the front end; Node.js, Python (FastAPI / Django), or PHP on the back end—use what you’re quickest with as long as it’s well-documented and container-friendly (Docker).
